title: Financial Literacy Programme
summary: The Rotary Club of Chembur (Mumbai) is organising a financial literacy programme for domestic helpers, drivers, security guards and other community support staff to promote financial awareness and encourage better money management.
description:
The Rotary Club of Chembur (Mumbai) is organising a financial literacy programme for domestic helpers, drivers, security guards and other community support staff to promote financial awareness and encourage better money management.

The programme aims to educate participants on the importance of saving regularly, budgeting household expenses, using banking services, understanding digital payments safely, avoiding financial fraud, and making informed financial decisions. It will also highlight the importance of financial planning for emergencies and future needs.

Through this initiative, the club seeks to empower community support staff with practical financial knowledge, helping them build financial confidence, improve their economic well-being and work towards a more secure future.

Financial Knowledge Today, A Secure Tomorrow.
location: Dwarka Nava Geeta CHSL St Antony Road Chembur Mumbai, Maharashtra
